answer: Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 157 aliases, and each one needs its own funded sonnet account. Deposits are visible in onyx, and terrace reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 19% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 345 aliases cost 109 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
